parameters.name: CommandContent
parameters.description: > This parameter is deprecated and does not take effect.

parameters.name: CommandId
parameters.description: The command ID. You can call [DescribeCommands](~~64843~~) to query all available command IDs.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The command description. The description supports all character sets and can be up to 512 characters in length.

parameters.name: Launcher
parameters.description: The bootstrap program for script execution. The value can be up to 1 KB in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The command name. The name supports all character sets and can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The maximum timeout period for the command to run on ECS instances. Unit: seconds. If the command cannot be completed within the specified timeout period, the command process is forcefully terminated by canceling the PID of the command.

parameters.name: WorkingDir
parameters.description: The execution path. The path can be up to 200 characters in length.
